map.💡 调节剂用量 ≈ 布重 × |ΔpH| × 系数；冰醋酸系数约 2g/(kg·: 💡 Adjusting agent dosage ≈ fabric weight × |ΔpH| × coefficient; the glacial acetic acid coefficient is about 2g/(kg·pH) and soda ash about 3g/(kg·pH)
map.布面pH宜中性或弱酸性（6.5～7.5），过高影响色光与手感: Fabric pH should be neutral or weakly acidic (6.5～7.5); too high affects shade and handle
map.本模型为经验估算，实际需小样试验校正: This model is an empirical estimate; in practice it must be corrected by small-scale trials
map.染色后中和处理：活性/直接染料皂洗后布面偏碱，估算冰醋酸用量回调至中性附近。: Neutralisation after dyeing: after soaping, reactive/direct dye fabrics tend to be alkaline, so estimate the glacial acetic acid dosage to bring them back to near neutral.
map.后整理前 pH 调节：确保布面 pH 落在安全范围（通常 4.0~7.5 视产品: pH adjustment before finishing: ensure the fabric pH falls in the safe range (usually 4.0~7.5 depending on the product) to avoid fibre damage or skin irritation.
map.布面 pH 异常排查：pH 偏离时反推前处理净洗或酸中和工序是否到位。: Troubleshooting abnormal fabric pH: when pH deviates, work backwards to check whether the pretreatment wash or acid neutralisation step was adequate.
map.活性染色布面中和示例: Example of neutralising reactive dyed fabric
map.布重 200 g、当前 pH 9.5、目标 pH 7.0，工具按冰醋酸中和曲线估: With fabric weight 200 g, current pH 9.5 and target pH 7.0, the tool estimates about 0.6% (on fabric weight) of diluted glacial acetic acid along the neutralisation curve; after adjustment, retesting pH in the 6.8~7.2 range means it is compliant.
map.为什么布面 pH 要控制？: Why must fabric pH be controlled?
map.染整后残余碱剂使布面 pH 偏高，长期影响色光、手感与后整理助剂效果，贴身纺织品: Residual alkali after dyeing and finishing raises the fabric pH, which over time affects shade, handle and the performance of finishing auxiliaries, and close-to-skin textiles may irritate the skin, so it must be neutralised into the standard range.
map.冰醋酸和纯碱分别用于什么情况？: When is glacial acetic acid used and when soda ash?
map.布面偏碱用冰醋酸（或稀酸）下调；若因前处理过度酸洗导致偏酸，则用纯碱回调。工具按: Use glacial acetic acid (or dilute acid) to bring down alkaline fabric; if over-acid-washing in pretreatment has left it acidic, use soda ash to bring it back up. The tool determines the direction automatically from the difference between current and target pH.
map.结果能直接用于大货吗？: Can the result be used directly for bulk production?
map.为中和用量估算参考，实际以 GB/T 7573 水萃取 pH 实测为准，具体助剂: It is a reference estimate for neutralising dosage; in practice follow the GB/T 7573 water-extraction pH measurement, and the specific auxiliary concentration and temperature must be combined with the on-site process.
map.染色后布面常残留碱剂，pH 偏高会影响色光、手感与后整理效果。本工具根据当前与目: Alkali agents often remain on fabric after dyeing, and a high pH affects shade, handle and finishing performance. This tool estimates the dosage of glacial acetic acid or soda ash from the difference between current and target pH and the fabric weight, and determines the adjustment direction automatically.
map.自动判断升/降 pH 方向: Automatically determines the raise/lower pH direction
map.冰醋酸与纯碱双调节剂支持: Supports both glacial acetic acid and soda ash
